ModMetaData.name: RimAI.Communication
ModMetaData.author: juicy
ModMetaData.description:
RimAI.Communication generates dynamic, context-aware colonist dialogue.
Conversations follow each pawn's mood, thoughts, and current work. You can control how often they talk and suppress messages you do not want.
Configure the shared RimAI text-AI provider in RimAI settings. Do not use translation or TTS credentials for gameplay dialogue.
